response.sql: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM per_transaction), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg FROM per_transaction AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_anlycount, k.avg_anlycount - k.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall, k.avg_anlycount - a.kept_avg AS difference_from_kept FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_average AS a ORDER BY difference_from_kept IS NULL, difference_from_kept DESC LIMIT 10;
